name: Bite-Sized Thunder - Power2Tri Endurance Coaching
description:
ABOUT ONGOING TRAINING
Every week we drop a fresh, coach-built workout designed to fit naturally into an athlete’s real training rhythm. These aren’t static repeats. Sessions ebb and flow with the broader race season, shifting from early-season durability to midseason sharpening and late-season precision.
You can expect structure, intention, and just enough sting to make you better. Some Tuesdays bring controlled work, others bring a bit of fire, but every session has a purpose. TT bikes are allowed and Draft is enabled.
If you’re looking for a consistent weekly touchpoint that actually fits into a periodized training plan, this is it.

WORKOUT DESIGNER
All sessions are created by Dave D’Abrosca, owner and head coach of Power2Tri Endurance Coaching. Dave is a USAT Level II Long Course and Ironman Certified Coach with decades of experience guiding athletes through hundreds of races across triathlon, long course, XTERRA, gravel, MTB, and running events up to ultra distance.
Dave leads most sessions and designs each workout to support athletes who want structure, accountability, and high quality training that complements their real world goals.
The Power2Tri coaching team is available for questions at http://www.power2tri-endurance.com/.
Follow our daily training insights on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/power2tri.endurance
JOIN THE POWER2TRI ZWIFT CLUB
Our Zwift Club is the easiest way to find and join all Power2Tri events inside the Companion App. When you’re part of the club, upcoming rides surface automatically, making it simple to stay consistent with Terrible Tuesdays and any other sessions we host.
We also now have an official Power2Tri kit in Zwift, and Club members can unlock and ride in it during group events.
Join the club here:
https://www.zwift.com/clubs/5819a1e5-7af5-437f-aab7-287c169c0cb2/home

name: Film My Run 500 with NoblePro
description:
Join Stephen Cousins and NoblePro for a 500 metre climb. Set your treadmill to 12% incline and run 4.2km of distance to reach 500 metres elevation. If your treadmill doesn't go that high, set it as high as it will go and join us anyway!

The run will be progressive starting at a walking pace of 5kph rising to 7kph for the final kilometre. Get on to the balls of your toes and get your calf muscles to do the work. This continuous uphill effort will help build strength and endurance for those hilly trail runs

This event is sponsored by the ever popular Noble Pro treadmills. You can get a discount on a NoblePro SMART treadmill from this link https://zwift.run/noble-pro

You can watch the run on the live stream at http://youtube.com/ZwiftRunChannel

Join the FMR Run Club for more fun events at https://www.zwift.com/uk/clubs/6afca04c-8fac-4ffa-b700-f27a73d7f3dd/join

description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

name: All American Bikes Ride presented by GRIT
description:
This is NOT a race, the ride will start with a warmup pace of 2.5 w/kg for all riders Yes, both A and B groups start together and stay together at the beginning! On flat sections near the start of the ride, we want both groups to stay together with a casual pace.

Join us for this social group ride. Our route will be a combination of flat sections and some big hills. The route will be selected to have 2 or 3 large hills during the ride.
Group A: Please join group A if you can maintain above 4.0 w/kg on short climbs.
Group B will be going uphill at 3.5 - 4.0 w/kg.
We want to increase the size of Group A. Please join group A if you are a strong group B rider. We want Group B to be riders that prefer 3.5 - 4.0 w/kg on climbs.
After hills, we will maintain 2 main groups. Group A riders that are in front of the group A leader should slow to rejoin the leader. Group B riders in front of the group B leader should slow to rejoin the leader. We ask for your cooperation to rejoin with your group to make this a fun social ride.

We welcome you to challenge yourself and join this ride even if you don't typically ride at this level. We often find riders join us and find that they can handle a higher intensity level by riding with a faster group.

GRIT: Great Rides for Intense Training

name: GGCC Glasgow Green Cycle Club Tuesday Training Ride
description:
This GGCC group ride is a TRAINING event, category D, with a yellow beacon leader. The beacon leader will ride between 1.5 and 2.5w/kg pace average wherever possible.

Please look out for our 4 training rides a week, every week - Tuesday’s D-ride at 11.00am and C-ride 20.45 UTC; Thursday’s C-ride at 21.00 UTC; and Saturday’s C-ride at 11.30am UTC. Use #ggcc to search for all our events, as in https://zwift.com/events/tag/ggcc

The Glasgow Green Cycle Club (GGCC) training rides are intended to provide a challenge for riders. You should ride as a group, following the instructions of the beacon ride leader(s) for any sprints, intervals and spicy segments, regrouping after each when requested. Some group rides also have a short closing minirace, to start from behind the beacon.

GGCC is a Glasgow based cycling club whose “in real life” (irl) club runs and training rides are always organized into pace groups, which match the Zwift categories quite well. GGCC also has a good race pedigree and presence in Scotland, and so we have created this training ride series to suit what we believe is relevant to any bike riders’ interests in performance and improvement in our own club, and elsewhere. 

Racers will, no doubt, aspire to try our other events: races on Mondays at  20.10 UTC, and 3 TTs on Fridays at 18.45, 19.15 and 19.45 UTC. 

Also look out for our 6Points Mallorca rides and races - Monday’s race at 20.10 UTC, Tuesday’s group D-ride at 09.55 UTC, and Sunday’s group C-ride at 11.40am UTC. Search for 6Points events at https://zwift.com/events/tag/6points.

As we expect our club’s riders to be able to ride 50 miles at a 15mph average on our Sunday rides, such steady riding members will be comfortable with Zwift Category D, or, for a challenge, Category C. In our various rides we cater for all abilities, through the Zwift ABCD levels. Beacon leaders communicate via Zwift messaging (always) and/or Discord (sometimes) to vary the pace to allow for sprints and intervals, with regrouping after each segment, and sometimes a short optional closing mini-race to finish the ride the rides,. Make as much use of drafting as you can, for more effective sprinting and intervals.

Results can be seen at the end of the ride on screen, and we will, in common with many other ride series, publish your results on zwiftpower.com too.

All bikes and PUs are allowed, but it’s better not to use TT bikes (which don’t draft) on our group rides and races. Please add GGCC (X) to your Zwift name to allow your ride presence to be recognized, where X is your desired ride category. Categories are related to your Functional Threshold Power (FTP); use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg, then pick the correct ride and group. This ride is categorized as:

D: 1.5 W/kg to 2.5 W/kg FTP; the beacon leader will ride to 2w/kg pace average.

PLEASE NOTE: Strava data for our rides must be open (not private or hidden). Please use a heart monitor so that we can monitor correlated power and heart rate to help assure fair riding.
You can use our Discord channel to talk to each other at https://discord.gg/UDhdEQA

For more about specific Zwift courses for our events, see the Zwift Companion schedule, and also https://zwiftinsider.com/ where there is a wealth of information about all things Zwift.

Please see the GGCC Zwift page link at http://www.glasgowgreencycleclub.co.uk/ for more.

#ggcc

name: CRYO-GEN Power Tuesday Group Ride
description:
Power Tuesday. The TGR Ride is a ride that has been organized for the many riders in the Zwift Community who wish to have a paced ride with friends and like-minded members of the community. The ride has been organised as a workout ride and will incorporate intervals.
 
If you are a stronger rider who has joined the group to possibly support others or to support a friend you can help the group Leader and others by watching the back of the group for any rider struggling to stay with the main group and assist if needed.

These events are held to assist with the attainment of your training goals and will include intervals over and below the ride average parameters. This is not a race so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the sweeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack. 

The pace will be kept at a manageable level to attempt to have all riders finish together. 
We will endeavor to have as many Sweepers as possible to assist any rider who is struggling.

There are no rules apart from enjoy the ride and try not to ride ahead of the group leader.

HEALTH: We would advise any rider who is attempting a Zwift ride for the first time to, ensure that their health should always take precedence over completing any ride. If you feel unwell or unable to continue please STOP 
NOTE: Exercise contributes to 25% weight loss; Healthy Eating (Not Diet) contributes to the other 75%. Be fit and Healthy.

name: Team Valhalla Wake-up North America Ride
description:
Wake Up North America!!!
It’s time for a good early morning or lunchtime stretch ride brought to you by the friendly folks at Vikings and Team Valhalla.
Our fat burn, “no drop” ride is totally unique to Zwift……2 great paces making 1 amazing ride.
Feeling energetic? Then ride with the Yellow beacon at 1.8-2.5 w/kg. Feel like taking it down a bit? Then ride with the Red beacon at 1.6-1.8 w/kg. Feel like chasing? Then bounce back and forth between Yellow and Red. Everybody is included in our hour-long party.
Join us for our special theme rides and some in ride-challenges to tempt your riding skills. Every ride is a bit different, but you can count on making new friends and enjoying plenty of banter and jokes each week. The only rule we have is to HAVE FUN!!
For more information about our rides go to: https://www.facebook.com/groups/503388660165279/ or https://www.skaal.cc

name: The XP Express with Rhino Racing
description:
All aboard The XP Express!

We're dishing out Double XP in this event so sign up, kit up and get ready to Level Up.

The XP Express is a turbocharged ride where every pedal stroke counts twice. Whether you're starting your Zwift journey or a seasoned pro, hop aboard to Level Up your ride.

How does it work?
The XP Express events will double your XP, helping you wrack up 40XP per kilometer or 64XP per mile! Leveling Up is the perfect way to unlock new swag, access to bikes and wheels, new routes and, of course, some bragging rights.

Use this event as an easy recovery ride, a quick warm up before your next race or push yourself to the limit to see how much XP you can earn.

name: Zwift Women's Training Club Workout
description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way! 

Join the Zwift Women’s Training Club to connect with new ride friends, ask questions, and get advice from experts.  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ZwiftWTC/join

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides every 3 hours on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays in addition to the Tuesday/Thursday workouts.

name: SISU World Cup - Game 4
description:
SISU Racing Launches the SISU World Game

The world will come together for football’s greatest spectacle this year — and now the world of cycling esports has its own global showdown.

Welcome to the SISU World Game.

Inspired by the spirit, passion and national pride of the FIFA World Cup, SISU Racing is proud to announce a brand-new international racing concept where every pedal stroke counts for your country.
Across four action-packed “Games”, riders won’t just race for individual glory — they’ll race for national pride.

In a unique twist, the winning rider’s country in each grade will claim victory for that stage, while the overall General Classification (GC) winners will determine the ultimate champion nations of the SISU World Game.

It’s a celebration of what makes SISU Racing special: global connection, fierce competition, and a community built from every corner of the world.

From Finland to Australia. From Canada to Denmark. From Belgium to the USA. From the UK to Poland.
One world. One start line.

And in true SISU fashion, the routes have been selected to test every type of rider — punchers, climbers, diesel engines, technical racers and tactical masterminds.

For more information and results see sisu.racing/worldcup

The Games

Game 1
Tuesday 9 June
Cobbles Crown – Richmond
The SISU World Game begins on the punchy cobbles of Richmond. Short climbs, rolling terrain and technical rhythm changes will demand explosive power and sharp race IQ. Positioning will be everything as nations battle for the first jersey and first bragging rights of the series.

Game 2
Tuesday 16 June
2018 UCI Worlds Short Lap – Innsbruck
A nod to one of cycling’s most iconic World Championship venues. Innsbruck delivers relentless climbing pressure and rewards riders who can suffer deep and keep pushing. Pure climbers and punchy all-rounders will smell opportunity here.

Game 3
Tuesday 23 June
Spinfinity – New York
Fast. Aggressive. Unpredictable.
New York’s futuristic roads bring high-speed racing with constant elevation changes and no room to hide. Expect attacks, counterattacks and nations fighting desperately for every second as the SISU World Game reaches its critical phase.

Game 4
Tuesday 30 June
Green to Screen – New York
The final Game promises fireworks.
Green to Screen is one of Zwift’s most demanding modern routes — beginning with fast flowing terrain before rising into a brutal uphill finale. This is where legends will be made, GC battles settled, and one nation crowned champion of the SISU World Game.

The SISU World Cup is another example of SISU Racing continuing to innovate within cycling esports.
This isn’t just about watts. It’s about identity, community and bringing riders together through the universal language of sport.

Every nation has a story. Every rider has a role to play.
And somewhere, one country will rise above the rest.
The world stage is waiting.
Let’s go racing!

name: DWGZ Endurance – Who Let the DWGZ Out?!
description:
Welcome to DWGZ (Determined Witty Gritty Zwifters) — a global crew of cyclists who show up with grit, humor, heart, and the kind of energy that lifts the whole group. DWGZ builds more than fitness — we build emotional endurance, community strength, and the kind of camaraderie that makes even the hardest efforts feel lighter through shared suffering.

Our Tuesday Endurance Ride is a punchy, higher-energy endurance session — typically (but not always) featuring a KOM climb segment, steady pressure, and the signature DWGZ vibe: gritty, supportive, and full of good watts and better banter.

Whether you’re pushing for fitness gains, sharpening your endurance, or rolling with a community that makes suffering fun, this ride is for you.

Ride Categories

🚴 B Category – 3.2–4.0 w/kg

🚴 C Category – 2.8–3.2 w/kg

🚴 D Category – 1.5–2.5 w/kg

Expect consistent pacing, a punchy segment(s), and a crew that brings the best energy on Zwift. From the beacon to our sweep team, every part of the ride is built on teamwork, grit, and connection.

DWGZ rides run Monday through Saturday at 6:05 AM Eastern (US) — each one an opportunity to build strength, connection, and global community.

Clip in, dig in, and bring the good energy - DWGZ: Get Gritty!

About DIRT

Team DIRT is an acronym for Dads Inside Riding Trainers — a community that has grown to include like-minded moms and dads who balance training with work and family life. A global tribe with a great vibe that makes you want to ride, DIRT is built on connection, encouragement, and fitting fitness into real life.

Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/sUnwqPZ

And on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/ZWIFTDIRT

name: Stage 5: Level Up Racing: Queen's Highway After Party
description:
Level Up Racing is June’s ZRacing monthly series. Race across five stages from June 1 to July 5, with a new route each week and up to 250 XP waiting at every banner. Complete stages to build series progress, chase the GC leaderboard, and grab bonus XP as you race.

Stage 5

Dates: June 29–July 5
Route: Queen’s Highway After Party
Laps: 1

name: Bite-Sized Thunder - Power2Tri Endurance Coaching
description:
ABOUT ONGOING TRAINING
Every week we drop a fresh, coach-built workout designed to fit naturally into an athlete’s real training rhythm. These aren’t static repeats. Sessions ebb and flow with the broader race season, shifting from early-season durability to midseason sharpening and late-season precision.
You can expect structure, intention, and just enough sting to make you better. Some Tuesdays bring controlled work, others bring a bit of fire, but every session has a purpose. TT bikes are allowed and Draft is enabled.
If you’re looking for a consistent weekly touchpoint that actually fits into a periodized training plan, this is it.

WORKOUT DESIGNER
All sessions are created by Dave D’Abrosca, owner and head coach of Power2Tri Endurance Coaching. Dave is a USAT Level II Long Course and Ironman Certified Coach with decades of experience guiding athletes through hundreds of races across triathlon, long course, XTERRA, gravel, MTB, and running events up to ultra distance.
Dave leads most sessions and designs each workout to support athletes who want structure, accountability, and high quality training that complements their real world goals.
The Power2Tri coaching team is available for questions at http://www.power2tri-endurance.com/.
Follow our daily training insights on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/power2tri.endurance
JOIN THE POWER2TRI ZWIFT CLUB
Our Zwift Club is the easiest way to find and join all Power2Tri events inside the Companion App. When you’re part of the club, upcoming rides surface automatically, making it simple to stay consistent with Terrible Tuesdays and any other sessions we host.
We also now have an official Power2Tri kit in Zwift, and Club members can unlock and ride in it during group events.
Join the club here:
https://www.zwift.com/clubs/5819a1e5-7af5-437f-aab7-287c169c0cb2/home

name: The Ride For Mental Health
description:
Let’s ride away the stigma!

The Ride For Mental Health (TRFMH) was started to support a community dedicated to eliminating the stigma of mental illness through education and open conversation.

This event is inspired by Eric Dorris, who suffered from borderline personality disorder and other disorders. His dad, Mac Dorris, founded TRFMH as a way to find hope, healing and purpose after Eric’s sudden and tragic death.

The Ride For Mental Health has emerged as the premier cycling fundraiser in the U.S. exclusively benefitting mental health. The proceeds raised will be donated to McLean Hospital, a Harvard Medical School affiliate, for the education, research and treatment of mental illness including anxiety, borderline personality disorder, depression, eating disorders and substance abuse.

name: Escape Collective Tuesday Escapade
description:
Welcome to the Escape Collective Tuesday Escapade group ride, brought to you by friends of the Escape Collective (escapecollective.cc). It’s the same crew and ride format formerly known as “The Placeholder Tuesday Group Ride”.

This is a fun social group ride with the aim of enjoying riding in the bunch and having a bit of banter all with a touch of (optional) friendly competition.

Ride with our playlist, just search for “Escape Collective Zwift Playlist” on Spotify. Hit Play as the ride starts and enjoy the tunes.

Come along and ride with the crew where our ride leader will set a pace of up to 2.5w/kg after a slower warmup. Our course varies each week and most weeks will be a flat route to help keep the bunch together. Each ride will have a sweeper with a few other riders who are available to help any riders come back to the group if asked for assistance.

This is a social group ride not a race, so please respect the pace set by the ride leader. Stick together to enjoy the draft and companionship. The ride leader will not exceed the advertised pace at any time - even on hills. Please keep an eye on the leader beacon (yellow) and the sweeper beacon (red) to stay in the blob - flat, hilly or in between!

To keep things interesting, we offer optional opportunities for a sprint each lap followed by a regroup. Depending on the week we have 2 different ride formats:

- FIRST TUESDAY OF THE MONTH - Lap the Field - After riding the first half of the ride together as a group, the red beacon will lead an optional chase group at a hard pace (around 4w/kg) and attempt to lap riders in the main bunch. Whilst the chase is occurring the main bunch will continue to ride with the yellow ride leader at the usual pace of around 2.5 w/kg. It’s up to you – try and keep up with the faster bunch in red, or ride steady with yellow! In both cases, please try to stick with your chosen bunch.

- All OTHER WEEKS - Standard Short Race Format - Our final few kilometers will be an optional race to the end. The ride leader will let you know the exact start point in plenty of time.
Join our Zwift club to keep in touch with upcoming rides, chat with other participants outside the ride time, or if you'd like to get involved in running the ride! Search for "Friends of Escape Collective" in Zwift Companion's clubs interface.

name: VO2sday Micro Race (1 of 5) by Zwift Insider
description:
Welcome to VO2sday - 5 short, back-to-back TT races designed to give you a properly structured VO2 Max workout in a motivating and engaging race!

RESULTS: Final race results combining all 5 events can be found at https://leadoutesports.com/vo2sday/. 

IMPORTANT: You need to create an account at Leadout and link it to your Zwift account to show up in race results.

All races are 4 minutes long. Whoever rides the furthest, wins! Be sure to complete all 5 races so you get a full workout and are included in the overall competition.

Because the goal is for you to hold your max power for the duration of each race, these are set up as mass-start time trial events. Drafting is disabled, so there's no 'sitting in.' Use the best TT frame and wheels you've got. Push as hard as you can for the race duration, then recover and do it again!

Categories are based on your compound score, which takes into account your 5-minute power and body weight, computed as (5-min power in W/kg) * (5-min power in W). Current category setup:

- A: 1600+
- B: 1200-1600
- C: 900-1200
- D: 900 and below

Welcome to VO2sday - 5 short, back-to-back TT races designed to give you a properly structured VO2 Max workout in a motivating and engaging race!

RESULTS: Final race results combining all 5 events can be found at https://leadoutesports.com/vo2sday/. 

IMPORTANT: You need to create an account at Leadout and link it to your Zwift account to show up in race results.

All races are 4 minutes long. Whoever rides the furthest, wins! Be sure to complete all 5 races so you get a full workout and are included in the overall competition.

Because the goal is for you to hold your max power for the duration of each race, these are set up as mass-start time trial events. Drafting is disabled, so there's no 'sitting in.' Use the best TT frame and wheels you've got. Push as hard as you can for the race duration, then recover and do it again!

Categories are based on your compound score, which takes into account your 5-minute power and body weight, computed as (5-min power in W/kg) * (5-min power in W). Current category setup:

- A: 1600+
- B: 1200-1600
- C: 900-1200
- D: 900 and below

The Time Trial. Cycling’s true leveler - just you and your legs versus everyone else in the field.

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. name: SROZ's Two-Tired for Tuesday
description:
Feeling "wheely" tired of the work week already? Pedal through the slump with the Striders and Riders of Zwift! Our "Two-Tired for Tuesday" social spin is here to help you get moving!

We’re all about fun, great support, and even better company. If you’re looking for a ride where respect and high-fives come standard, you’ve found your pack.

We keep it social and steady. While the terrain might throw some curveballs, we aim for a sweet-spot average of 18-20 mph (30-32 kph).

Stick with the leader’s peloton! We’re better together...plus, you’ll save a ton of energy by tucking into that group draft.

Feeling a little gapped? Don't sweat it. We strive to have a dedicated sweeper on every ride to help pull you back into the fold.

The "Gene Autry" Philosophy: We believe in freedom! As the legend himself said, we won’t fence you in.

At the end of the day, you’re the captain of your own bike. Whether you’re pushing the pace or soaking in the scenery: ride your ride!

So come out, enjoy the virtual fresh air, and keep the faith!

name: Zwift Women's Training Club Workout
description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way! 

Join the Zwift Women’s Training Club to connect with new ride friends, ask questions, and get advice from experts.  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ZwiftWTC/join

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides every 3 hours on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays in addition to the Tuesday/Thursday workouts.

name: The XP Express - Run
description: All aboard The XP Express! We're dishing out Double XP in this event so sign up, lace up your shoes and get ready to Level Up. The XP Express is the "super shoe" of Zwift running, where every stride counts twice. Whether you're starting your Zwift journey or a seasoned pro, hop aboard to Level Up your run. How does it work? The XP Express events will double your XP, helping you wrack up 80XP per kilometer or 120XP per mile! Leveling Up is the perfect way to unlock new swag, and of course some bragging rights. Use this event as an easy recovery run, a quick warm up before your next race or push yourself to the limit to see how much XP you can earn.

name: Outseason Tuesdays with Endurance Nation
description:
Transform Your Winter with Endurance Nation’s OutSeason Program!

Get ready to build next-level fitness with our 9-week OutSeason cycling series! Join us every Tuesday and Thursday for a focused, one-hour session designed to boost your strength, endurance, and power. With just two workouts per week, you’ll start building winter strength that will prepare you to reach your goals next season. This program is tried-and-true, with over 10,000 athletes using it to succeed in cycling and triathlon for over 16 years.

Why settle for base miles alone when you can add targeted intensity this winter? Join Endurance Nation and see what a season of smart training can do. Discover more about the OutSeason at www.endurancenation.us/zwift.

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides on Saturdays, Sundays and Mondays each week — they are great alternates to these scheduled workouts!

name: Stage 5: Level Up Racing: Queen's Highway After Party
description:
Level Up Racing is June’s ZRacing monthly series. Race across five stages from June 1 to July 5, with a new route each week and up to 250 XP waiting at every banner. Complete stages to build series progress, chase the GC leaderboard, and grab bonus XP as you race.

Stage 5

Dates: June 29–July 5
Route: Queen’s Highway After Party
Laps: 1
Distance: 19.8 km
Elevation: 301 m

The series wraps with Queen’s Highway After Party, a single-lap finale with the biggest elevation total of the month. One last chance to race, earn bonus XP, and finish June strong.

MONTHLY GC COMPETITION

Looking for extra motivation? The Monthly GC (General Classification) Competition lets you track your progress across all stages. Each race counts—your times add up throughout the series, shaping the overall standings. At the end of the month, the fastest total time takes the win!

VIEW RESULTS: http://zwift.com/racing/leagues/zracingjun2026
—------------------
Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh


ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter


Hourly ZRacing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: RCC Global Club Ride
description:
WELCOME TO THE RAPHA CYCLING CLUB WORLD WIDE GROUP RIDE. 
 
This is a social group workout; a chance every week for members to get together from around the globe, ride, chat and support each other - it’s run as a group workout session with ‘keep everyone together’ enabled so no matter what your pace you’ll stay in the pack - it’s not a race or competition and open for anyone to join us. 
We host 4 rides every week on a Tuesday to suit different time zones around the world (aimed at evenings), join whichever time works best for you. 
 
WHO IS THE RCC?
 
The Rapha Cycling Club (RCC) is, as the name suggests, Rapha’s Cycling Club. The RCC exists to help connect like minded riders from all over the world, underpinned by Rapha’s products and experiences. We ride together across continents and here united within Zwift. 
 
For more information head to: www.Rapha.cc/rcc
 
RIDE LEADERS
 
The rides are led by our friendly team of member ride leaders from around the world.  The Leader (who has a yellow beacon over their head) will ride at a steady pace as set by the workout session. Prompts will appear on screen set by the workout designer Matt Rowe so you know what to do throughout the ride. On most occasions we will have a support ride leader (who will also have a beacon), the ride leaders are there to help support you and keep the banter going - to join the chat use the Zwift Companion smartphone app. 
 
ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS
 
Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.
 
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

Today's workout contains 4 x 6 minute blocks of Zone 3, with some surges thrown in for good measure! The Zone 3 riding should feel nice and comfortable, however the surges may sting a little. The surges in each block are only 20 seconds long, but at 110% of FTP so require a focused increase in effort .At the end of each 6 minute block, there is a 1 minute 'Free Ride' - this is your chance to turn an endurance based session into something special! Come event day or when riding with friends, it's likely you want some more power for that final sprint to the cafe right? Give it 100% in each 60 second Free Ride section to help you become more explosive! Stress points 45: #Social
 
 
WORKOUT DESIGNER
 
Matt Rowe is the founder of Rowe & King Coaching (www.roweandking.com) with 25 years of cycling experience, coaching amateur cyclists all over the world to  achieve their personal goals.
 
HELPFUL HINT
 
We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level.
You can adjust the difficulty of the workout mid-ride if needed, by using the up/down arrows on the left hand side, under the workout details.
 
HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#rcc

name: The Grind Finale
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

This session aims to replicate the demands of a mountain bike ride / event. 

Mountain biking generally involves far more variations in effort compared with road riding - so plenty of surges and time spent being over geared! We also spend a lot of time on and off the power, so short spells going  hard to get over an obstacle, followed by a freewheel or very low power on a descent or little dip.

We touch upon all of these aspects in todays session, as we start off alternating every 30 seconds between riding hard at a low cadence, and riding easy - as if we are riding through an undulating single track. Then we make a ramp in effort, which finishes with a 30 second near max effort up a steep, rocky banking!

WORKOUT DESIGNER

Matt Rowe - Heavily involved in cycling for the past 25 years, Matt represented Great Britain at the Junior World Championships before graduating to the pro ranks. Matt draws on his extensive race experience to help amateur cyclists around the world achieve their personal goals. 

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: Le Col SUB6 Endurance Series
description: Starting on Tuesday 22nd October at 06:30 MST, join RAAM World Record Holder Lucas Clarke for the Le Col SUB6 Endurance Series on Zwift. Whether you’re preparing for ultra-distance events like Race Across America (RAAM), Transcontinental and Mallorca 312, aiming for your first ultra or looking to refine your training, this series is your key to mastering endurance.

name: Team DRAFT Tuesday Race
description:
Welcome to the Tuesday Race brought to you by Team DRAFT!
We encourage that all participants head over to zwiftpower.com and register. For more information see: https://zwiftinsider.com/zwiftpower-signup/ Riders who have not completed the Zwiftpower registration will not be included in the official race results. We also ask that your Zwift activities be saved publicly, and that you open and maintain a Strava account to allow for organizer analysis. Any rider exhibiting questionable performance during a the race may be disqualified.

RULES:
- No zPower riders.
- Heart rate monitors mandatory for all categories
- 5min and 20min CEVAZ limits apply. Riding in the wrong category will lead to disqualification.

RACE CATEGORIES:
A: 4.0 W/kg to 5.0 W/kg
B: 3.2 W/kg to 3.99 W/kg
C: 2.5 W/kg to 3.19 W/kg
D: Under 2.49 W/kg

name: SWX Sweet Spot Tuesday by Coach Cindy
description:
Build strength and stamina every Tuesday with SWX Sweet Spot — a high-quality interval session designed to improve endurance and cycling performance.
Created by Coach Cindy (Train Smart = Race Stronger), this session targets the sweet spot between tempo and threshold — the perfect balance of challenge and sustainability. Bring focus, consistency, and strong legs!

• All levels welcome
• Stay-together mode enabled
• Late join allowed

Connect and learn more about who we are:
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/shark_worx_swx
🌐 Website: https://bit.ly/Visit_Coach_Cindy

name: EVO CC Sprint Race Series
description:
Welcome to EVO sprintrace series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: The XP Express with Wobble Cycle Club
description:
All aboard The XP Express!

We're dishing out Double XP in this event so sign up, kit up and get ready to Level Up.

The XP Express is a turbocharged ride where every pedal stroke counts twice. Whether you're starting your Zwift journey or a seasoned pro, hop aboard to Level Up your ride.

How does it work?
The XP Express events will double your XP, helping you wrack up 40XP per kilometer or 64XP per mile! Leveling Up is the perfect way to unlock new swag, access to bikes and wheels, new routes and, of course, some bragging rights.

Use this event as an easy recovery ride, a quick warm up before your next race or push yourself to the limit to see how much XP you can earn.

name: Epic Run Crew: Tuesday Trot
description:
You survived Monday! Let’s make Tuesday terrific by joining us for a friendly social run.
This is a 45 minute group run. You are welcome to run at your own pace (AYOP). Chatting is encouraged! Talk about food. Make a funny observation. Whatever. We don’t judge. Just have some fun!
Epic Run Crew is based in Vancouver, BC, Canada. We were founded as an in-person club in 2021 and then joined Zwift in June 2022.
Use the Zwift Companion app to join the Epic Run Crew club, for access to exclusive member-only group runs.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/epicruncrew2/
Instagram: @epicruncrew

name: Braunstein Cycling Club Danish Group Ride
description:
This is a social group workout; a chance every week for members to get together from around the globe, ride, chat and support each other - it’s run as a group workout session with ‘keep everyone together’ enabled so no matter what your pace you’ll stay in the pack - it’s not a race or competition and open for anyone to join us.

WHO IS THE BCC?

The BRAUNSTEIN Cycling Club (BCC) is, as the name suggests, Braunstein brewery’s Cycling Club. The BCC is a danish social Cycling club were we share our passion for Cycling.

For more information head to: www.braunstein.dk/bcc2

RIDE LEADERS

The rides are led by our friendly team of member ride leaders. The Leader (who has a yellow beacon over their head) will ride at a steady pace as set by the workout session. On most occasions we will have a support ride leader (who will also have a beacon), the ride leaders are there to help support you and keep the banter going - to join the chat use the Zwift Companion smartphone app.

Map/Route — Wattopia
Distance/Time/Laps — 1 hour
Type of Event - Group Ride
ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.

name: Dubai Roadsters Club ride
description: This is a fast paced, fun ride at the top end of the C category. It is not a race, just a pacey bit of fun. The average speed for the ride is aprx 40kph and the average watts/kilo is 2.9 to 3.0 each week, although the nature of the lumpy Central Park course can cause this to spike a couple of times each lap. The focus of the ride is to have fun and enjoy riding in a fast moving peloton.

name: DBR Tuesday Race
description:
Welcome to DBR Tuesday Race.
All will start with 1 minute between RS categories. Expect each race to be highly competitive and have fun.
Categories
Each race will be using Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) for categorization.
race up a category, if your RS is at the top end of a category. Or if you simply desire an added challenge.
- A: 1000 =< 690
- B:690<520
- C:520<350
- D:350<180
- E:180<=0
Your Zwift Racing Score is determined by how much success you have in races.
better against people with higher ZRS, then your ZRS may increase. If you place worse than people with lower ZRS, then your score might decrease. Read more about ZRS here - https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh <https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh>
If your ZRS increases past a category boundary during the series, your points earned will not transfer to the new category with you.
RULES:
Smart trainer or power meter is required. zPower will be removed.
Heart rate monitors are compulsory for all categories.
No TT bikes unless it's a TT event.
You need to have a registered account with Zwiftpower.com and accept their terms and conditions to be in the results of the race.
Misc.
Race organizers may request riders in all categories to provide a dual recording or a matching RL effort (Strava) in order to verify a Zwift race effort. Failure to comply may result in disqualification from the event. Failure to provide a dual recording or RL effort on three requests may result in disqualification from future events, until a dual recording with a matching effort is provided.
Race organizers may exclude a rider from the results, due to poor sportsmanship. Examples may be bad language, sandbagging or other behavior of a disruptive manner.

description: All aboard The XP Express! We're dishing out Double XP in this event so sign up, lace up your shoes and get ready to Level Up. name: Outseason Tuesdays with Endurance Nation
description:
Transform Your Winter with Endurance Nation’s OutSeason Program!

Get ready to build next-level fitness with our 9-week OutSeason cycling series! Join us every Tuesday and Thursday for a focused, one-hour session designed to boost your strength, endurance, and power. With just two workouts per week, you’ll start building winter strength that will prepare you to reach your goals next season. This program is tried-and-true, with over 10,000 athletes using it to succeed in cycling and triathlon for over 16 years.

Why settle for base miles alone when you can add targeted intensity this winter? Join Endurance Nation and see what a season of smart training can do. Discover more about the OutSeason at www.endurancenation.us/zwift.

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides on Saturdays, Sundays and Mondays each week — they are great alternates to these scheduled workouts!

name: Group Run 10k
description:
Join us for a 10k group run.   It's run-at-your-own-pace and all are welcome! 

Pick the closest pace group for you, but all groups will start together and you are free to fall back and run ahead. The pace groups designate average pace for the duration of the run. Most groups will start slower and finish faster than the indicated pace. Feel free to mix in some intervals and race your friends. #pbt

name: Stage 5: Level Up Racing: Queen's Highway After Party
description:
Level Up Racing is June’s ZRacing monthly series. Race across five stages from June 1 to July 5, with a new route each week and up to 250 XP waiting at every banner. Complete stages to build series progress, chase the GC leaderboard, and grab bonus XP as you race.

Stage 5

Dates: June 29–July 5
Route: Queen’s Highway After Party
Laps: 1
Distance: 19.8 km
Elevation: 301 m

The series wraps with Queen’s Highway After Party, a single-lap finale with the biggest elevation total of the month. One last chance to race, earn bonus XP, and finish June strong.

MONTHLY GC COMPETITION

Looking for extra motivation? The Monthly GC (General Classification) Competition lets you track your progress across all stages. Each race counts—your times add up throughout the series, shaping the overall standings. At the end of the month, the fastest total time takes the win!

VIEW RESULTS: http://zwift.com/racing/leagues/zracingjun2026
—------------------
Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh


ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter


Hourly ZRacing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: Dusk Patrol Run
description:
DESCRIPTION

Join Utah-based marathon runner Jordan Maddocks who will lead a 45-60 minute speed session.

Welcome to Dusk Patrol 'Zwift Academy Run' Edition. Each week we will do a speed workout from the 2020 Zwift Academy Run catalog (catalog can be found in the training folder on the home screen). We will do one of the 8 workouts each week in chronological order every Tuesday at 7AM Mountain / 9AM Eastern. Each workout ranges between 45-60 min. These workouts were built to help strengthen athletes of all abilities and help build for race day. All of the workouts use your 10K speed bias setting in Zwift -- this pace time can be adjusted in settings to increase/decrease level of difficulty. Need More Speed? If you're looking for an additional speed workout during the week you're welcome to join us for Thursday Dusk Patrol which starts at same time (8:30AM MT/10:30AM ET).

ABOUT

ABOUT Jordan Maddocks
I'm a low 2:30's marathoner fighting out of Draper, Utah, USA. I’ve been running for over 15 years. Running is my passion, It's what keeps me centered and where I find solace. I love coaching and assisting others in setting their fitness goals and achieving them. I've been hosting Dusk Patrol on Zwift for over three years. When I'm not training I'm spending time with my momma bear and two cubs. Running has the magical ability to assist others in finding their greatness and I hope I can share that journey with you.

name: MHG Run Club
description:
Back in January 2021, Eddie Izzard ran 32 marathons in 31 days. Our community rallied together and joined the action all month long. This inspired us to create the MHG Run Club, which continues Eddie’s incredible efforts of making humanity great.

The MHG Run Club motivates and supports everybody, whether you’re looking for tips to achieve your training goals or looking for a group to bond and socialize with. A light-minded Zwift treadmill runners group, for runners of all abilities, friendly chat and a good laugh :)

Please feel free to join me Clive Finnimore with our official MHG Run Club Lunchtime 5K @ 8KPH on Monday, Wednesday & Fridays, See you there soon :)

Keep on Running

name: Film My Run 500 with NoblePro
description:
Join Stephen Cousins and NoblePro for a 500 metre climb. Set your treadmill to 12% incline and run 4.2km of distance to reach 500 metres elevation. If your treadmill doesn't go that high, set it as high as it will go and join us anyway!

The run will be progressive starting at a walking pace of 5kph rising to 7kph for the final kilometre. Get on to the balls of your toes and get your calf muscles to do the work. This continuous uphill effort will help build strength and endurance for those hilly trail runs

This event is sponsored by the ever popular Noble Pro treadmills. You can get a discount on a NoblePro SMART treadmill from this link https://zwift.run/noble-pro

You can watch the run on the live stream at http://youtube.com/ZwiftRunChannel

name: Zwift Women's Training Club Workout
description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way! 

Join the Zwift Women’s Training Club to connect with new ride friends, ask questions, and get advice from experts.  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ZwiftWTC/join

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides every 3 hours on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays in addition to the Tuesday/Thursday workouts.

name: Team Africa Rising
description:
The Team Africa Rising Zwift Ride showcases our efforts in African cycling development. On this ride, you may be joined by some of our African cyclists from around the continent including Benin, Sierra Leone, Rwanda, DRC (Congo), and Uganda. Enjoy all the different African flags! You may even ride with former Rwandan Olympian (2012/2016) and World Tour cyclist (Team DiData), Adrien Niyonshuti.

We use this ride as a training and recovery ride for our African cyclists. We have Benin coaches who use this ride to train new Benin cyclists on how to shift, stay with the peloton and establish a consistent pedal stroke. So, you’ll be part of history during this ride! This event is run by members of Team Africa Rising, Adrien Niyonshuti, and all the up-and-coming coaches and cyclists of Benin and other countries to help them better learn to engage with fans and other riders. Sometimes we’ll have guest leads to talk to you about our work with Team Africa Rising.

The ride will remain a D+/C- ride. The team will adhere to the 1.5 - 2.0 w/kg range. The lead will ride at the top end, the sweep will ride at the lower end and will help riders if they want to make it back to the pack.

On this ride, we encourage chatting as it teaches the riders English. YOU will be a part of helping these young men and women build and lead their own rides. How cool is that?

You can follow us on our Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/groups/teamafricarising

Learn more about Team Africa Rising on our website: https://teamafricarising.org

name: Love Riding's 2.0wkg Coffee Ride
description:
Welcome to the Love Riding Club’s Coffee Ride! We meet every Tuesday for a casual, conversational
ride at a pace that falls within most people’s Zone 2 range (average pace between 1.8 – 2.2 wkg). We
are a friendly bunch and conversation is encouraged as it’s a great way to make sure you’re not going
too hard!
Sprinting is encouraged as long as you can make your way back to the group in time.
Tip: If you are new to sprints, it is best to sprint from the back of the pack to take advantage of the draft
and you won’t go out too far ahead of the group!

The lead yellow beacon will maintain the average advertised pace and the sweep red beacon will help
those who fall behind to catch up with the main group. We welcome riders who feel strong or want a
challenge to help the sweep team so please just shout up in the chat!

We tend to run the fence to help keep the group together, this will be relaxed at the sprints.
Please respect the lead beacon and make the effort to stay as close as possible to him/her for the benefit
of the whole group.

We LOVE to ride and we LOVE Coffee Rides! Looking forward to seeing you all on Tuesdays,
whether you’re warming up for a race, recovering, or just getting into cycling and this is at your
challenge level. We welcome you all!

Join us on Facebook to continue the chat, provide feedback and take part in how the club shapes in the
future.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/5437161913060756/

or Join our Zwift Club
Love Riding Club – find us in the club search
Find out events by filtering #loveriding

Velofit specialiserer sig i kvalitet og personlig service inden for cykling. name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: SISU World Cup - Game 4
description:
SISU Racing Launches the SISU World Game

The world will come together for football’s greatest spectacle this year — and now the world of cycling esports has its own global showdown.

Welcome to the SISU World Game.

Inspired by the spirit, passion and national pride of the FIFA World Cup, SISU Racing is proud to announce a brand-new international racing concept where every pedal stroke counts for your country.
Across four action-packed “Games”, riders won’t just race for individual glory — they’ll race for national pride.

In a unique twist, the winning rider’s country in each grade will claim victory for that stage, while the overall General Classification (GC) winners will determine the ultimate champion nations of the SISU World Game.

It’s a celebration of what makes SISU Racing special: global connection, fierce competition, and a community built from every corner of the world.

From Finland to Australia. From Canada to Denmark. From Belgium to the USA. From the UK to Poland.
One world. One start line.

And in true SISU fashion, the routes have been selected to test every type of rider — punchers, climbers, diesel engines, technical racers and tactical masterminds.

For more information and results see sisu.racing/worldcup

The Games

Game 1
Tuesday 9 June
Cobbles Crown – Richmond
The SISU World Game begins on the punchy cobbles of Richmond. Short climbs, rolling terrain and technical rhythm changes will demand explosive power and sharp race IQ. Positioning will be everything as nations battle for the first jersey and first bragging rights of the series.

Game 2
Tuesday 16 June
2018 UCI Worlds Short Lap – Innsbruck
A nod to one of cycling’s most iconic World Championship venues. Innsbruck delivers relentless climbing pressure and rewards riders who can suffer deep and keep pushing. Pure climbers and punchy all-rounders will smell opportunity here.

Game 3
Tuesday 23 June
Spinfinity – New York
Fast. Aggressive. Unpredictable.
New York’s futuristic roads bring high-speed racing with constant elevation changes and no room to hide. Expect attacks, counterattacks and nations fighting desperately for every second as the SISU World Game reaches its critical phase.

Game 4
Tuesday 30 June
Green to Screen – New York
The final Game promises fireworks.
Green to Screen is one of Zwift’s most demanding modern routes — beginning with fast flowing terrain before rising into a brutal uphill finale. This is where legends will be made, GC battles settled, and one nation crowned champion of the SISU World Game.

The SISU World Cup is another example of SISU Racing continuing to innovate within cycling esports.
This isn’t just about watts. It’s about identity, community and bringing riders together through the universal language of sport.

Every nation has a story. Every rider has a role to play.
And somewhere, one country will rise above the rest.
The world stage is waiting.
Let’s go racing!

name: CMC Southern African Winter Series - Stage 1
description:
This racing series will be hosted over a period of five (5) weeks from 30 June - 28 July 2026.

Anyone is welcome to join, but two (2) separate logs will be kept: (1) an overall log; and (2) a log for anyone living within any of the following Southern African countries: South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Zambia, Malawi, Angola, Mozambique, Eswatini and Lesotho.

Furthermore, these logs will also be kept by Mixed category and Ladies-only category, all within the standard Zwift Racing Score categories. Each racer’s best 4 scores will count toward the overall score, allowing a racer to miss a single race and still be competitive.

Points will be scored according to finishing position within your group. The series will comprise 3 x Scratch races (one flat, one climb and one rolling), 1 x Individual Time Trial (iTT) and 1 x Crit race.

Week 1 - Douce France (France) - Flat and fast - 24.2km with 137m elevation

Week 2 - Legends and Lava (Watopia) - Climbing up Titans Grove Rev. KOM and finishing on top of Volcano KOM - 24.7km with 352m elevation

Week 3 - iTT on Hot Laps (Watopia) - 4 laps of the Volcano circuit before finishing on top of the Jarvis KOM - 23.5km with 149m elevation

Week 4 - Sand and Sequoias (Watopia) - 31.4km (non-standard finishing line) with approx 200m elevation

Week 5 - Downtown Dolphin (Crit City) - 10 x 2km laps - Fast and Furious racing with a small sting in the middle of each lap - 19.6km with 170m elevation

Racing Rules:

Races will be categorised according to the standard Zwift racing average watt split.  Please ensure you enter in the correct category.

For results to be valid, a power source (smart trainer or power meter) and heart rate (HR) monitor will be required.

zPower riders and those not wearing a HR monitor will not appear in results.

Kindly maintain an open Strava profile to enable the organiser to validate your performance.

Unrealistic performances may be disqualified.

You must be resident in a Southern African country to qualify for the Southern African league table.  Everyone will be visible in the overall league table.

Should you be upgraded during the series to a higher category, you will automatically carry half your accumulated across to the higher category.

Should you be downgraded to a lower category during the series, you will automatically carry all your accumulated across to the lower category.

Any questions – contact Mario - +27832661937

name: FCC Hot Summer Nights
description:
Get ready to clip in, power up, and race your watts off. The FemmeCycle Collab is proud to present Hot Summer Nights - an eight-week racing series designed to test every facet of your virtual racing game — from explosive sprints to individual time trial efforts to tactical pack racing.

Across eight weeks, riders will tackle four distinct race styles, each featured for two weeks of the series:

- **Mini Races (Weeks x2):** Short, sharp, and brutal. Quick-hit formats where every second counts and there's nowhere to hide. These mini races count as THREE RACES, but you must complete ALL THREE to get points for the week.
- **Individual Time Trials (Weeks x2):** Just you, the watts, and the clock. Pace it right and the leaderboard is yours.
- **Scratch Races (Weeks x2):** Classic mass-start racing — first wheel across the line takes it. Tactics, positioning, and a well-timed kick are your best friends.
- **Points Races (Weeks x2):** Sprint zones reward the brave. Rack up points throughout the race and don't save it all for the finish.

**Classifications**

Riders can compete for both **individual** and **team** classifications. For the individual GC, your **best 6 results out of 8 weeks** will count toward your final standing — so you can drop your two roughest days and still go for the win.  You do not need to compete in all events for your points to count towards your team's classification - join for 1, 2, or all 8 weeks to help your team climb the ladder!

**Two Timezones, One Series**

Each week offers **two timezone-friendly race slots** so riders around the world can join in. Pick the time that works for your schedule — but note: **your points only count toward the classification for the timezone you race in.** Choose your home base and stick with it to make every result stack toward your final ranking.

**Who It's For**

Whether you're a seasoned Zwift racer or chasing your first virtual podium, the FemmeCycle Collab Hot Summer Nights is built to celebrate, challenge, and elevate the women of the Zwift racing community. Bring your legs, bring your friends, and bring your team — we'll see you on the start line.

name: RCC Global Club Ride
description:
WELCOME TO THE RAPHA CYCLING CLUB WORLD WIDE GROUP RIDE. 

This is a social group workout; a chance every week for members to get together from around the globe, ride, chat and support each other - it’s run as a group workout session with ‘keep everyone together’ enabled so no matter what your pace you’ll stay in the pack - it’s not a race or competition and open for anyone to join us. 

We host 4 rides every week on a Tuesday to suit different time zones around the world (aimed at evenings), join whichever time works best for you. 
 
WHO IS THE RCC?
 
The Rapha Cycling Club (RCC) is, as the name suggests, Rapha’s Cycling Club. The RCC exists to help connect like minded riders from all over the world, underpinned by Rapha’s products and experiences. We ride together across continents and here united within Zwift. 
 
For more information head to: www.Rapha.cc/rcc
 
RIDE LEADERS
 
The rides are led by our friendly team of member ride leaders from around the world.  The Leader (who has a yellow beacon over their head) will ride at a steady pace as set by the workout session. Prompts will appear on screen set by the workout designer Matt Rowe so you know what to do throughout the ride. On most occasions we will have a support ride leader (who will also have a beacon), the ride leaders are there to help support you and keep the banter going - to join the chat use the Zwift Companion smartphone app. 
 
ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS
 
Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.
 
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

Today's workout contains 4 x 6 minute blocks of Zone 3, with some surges thrown in for good measure! The Zone 3 riding should feel nice and comfortable, however the surges may sting a little. The surges in each block are only 20 seconds long, but at 110% of FTP so require a focused increase in effort .At the end of each 6 minute block, there is a 1 minute 'Free Ride' - this is your chance to turn an endurance based session into something special! Come event day or when riding with friends, it's likely you want some more power for that final sprint to the cafe right? Give it 100% in each 60 second Free Ride section to help you become more explosive! Stress points 45: #Social
 
 
WORKOUT DESIGNER
 
Matt Rowe is the founder of Rowe & King Coaching (www.roweandking.com) with 25 years of cycling experience, coaching amateur cyclists all over the world to  achieve their personal goals.
 
HELPFUL HINT
 
We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level.
You can adjust the difficulty of the workout mid-ride if needed, by using the up/down arrows on the left hand side, under the workout details.
 
HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

GC Ride – German Cycling Community Ride
Fahre gemeinsam mit der German Cycling Community auf Zwift!
Der GC Ride ist eine offene Gruppenfahrt für alle, die gemeinsam Rad fahren möchten.
🚴 Offen für alle Fahrerinnen und Fahrer
🚴 Kein Rennen – entspanntes Gruppentempo

Die GC Rides stehen für Motivation, Austausch und gemeinsames Fahren.

name: Stage 5: Level Up Racing: Queen's Highway After Party | Advanced
description:
Level Up Racing is June’s ZRacing monthly series. Race across five stages from June 1 to July 5, with a new route each week and up to 250 XP waiting at every banner. Complete stages to build series progress, chase the GC leaderboard, and grab bonus XP as you race.

Stage 5

Dates: June 29–July 5
Route: Queen’s Highway After Party
Laps: 1
Distance: 19.8 km
Elevation: 301 m

The series wraps with Queen’s Highway After Party, a single-lap finale with the biggest elevation total of the month. One last chance to race, earn bonus XP, and finish June strong.

MONTHLY GC COMPETITION

Looking for extra motivation? The Monthly GC (General Classification) Competition lets you track your progress across all stages. Each race counts—your times add up throughout the series, shaping the overall standings. At the end of the month, the fastest total time takes the win!

VIEW RESULTS: http://zwift.com/racing/leagues/zracingjun2026
—------------------
Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh


ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter


Hourly ZRacing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: VO2sday Micro Race (3 of 5) by Zwift Insider
description:
Welcome to VO2sday - 5 short, back-to-back TT races designed to give you a properly structured VO2 Max workout in a motivating and engaging race!

RESULTS: Final race results combining all 5 events can be found at https://leadoutesports.com/vo2sday/. 

IMPORTANT: You need to create an account at Leadout and link it to your Zwift account to show up in race results.

All races are 4 minutes long. Whoever rides the furthest, wins! Be sure to complete all 5 races so you get a full workout and are included in the overall competition.

Because the goal is for you to hold your max power for the duration of each race, these are set up as mass-start time trial events. Drafting is disabled, so there's no 'sitting in.' Use the best TT frame and wheels you've got. Push as hard as you can for the race duration, then recover and do it again!

Categories are based on your compound score, which takes into account your 5-minute power and body weight, computed as (5-min power in W/kg) * (5-min power in W). Current category setup:

- A: 1600+
- B: 1200-1600
- C: 900-1200
- D: 900 and below

name: ZZRC Chain Reaction Sub 2
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Chain Reaction Sub 2. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.7-1.9 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be sub 2 .

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel for our sub 2
https://discord.gg/RJ3dhbjCEp


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: WKG - CRITTY CRITTY BANG BANG
description:
Critty Critty Bang Bang is a restless charge around 14 laps of the Downtown Dolphin course.

Covering a total of 27km with an elevation of 112m, all at breakneck speeds, your task is simple… make your opponents go BANG before you do!

Races will be regularly featured in the WKG ‘Watts Up!’ Vlogs (https://www.youtube.com/c/WKG111 <https://www.youtube.com/c/WKG111>) or live streamed on the Team WKG Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/zwiftoholic/ <https://www.facebook.com/zwiftoholic/>).

Race Rules:
1. You MUST have a zwiftpower profile
2. You must select your category correctly, based on recent race history or FTP tests. WKG reserves the right to disqualify any racers that have obviously entered the wrong category.
3. NO TT bikes (except for the time trial stages)
4. ALL power-ups are allowed.
5. You MUST use a heart rate monitor.

Ride Hard, Ride Smart, Ride Fair, Ride On!

name: Hotchillee WOT (Watts on Tuesday)
description:
Hotchillee WOT (Watts on Tuesday)
WOT is a structured workout session that follows a rolling 16-week progressive Plan.
It doesn't matter where you pick it up as you'll work through all of the energy systems.
Just make sure your FTP is accurately set to get the most out of the workouts.
Weeks 1-4: Big Gear/Low Cadence
Weeks 5-8: Sweet-Spot / Threshold Intervals
Weeks 9-12: VO2 / Zone 5 Intervals
Weeks 13-16: Anaerobic Capacity Intervals

Find out more about Hotchillee and join the gang at www.hotchillee.com

name: SZR Climbing Crew
description:
Please join the SZR Climbing Crew as we ride some of the more challenging bumpy routes each week.
After climbs / descents we will try to focus on getting the back of the group together.
The goal with an SZR Ride is to focus on the Group and keeping the Group together while having fun to make the time fly fast! You should aim to sit between the fence and the yellow / red beacon.
The ride tempo is shown next to the ride category, this is rider weight / gender dependant.
Note that the average is for the total ride! There might be variations above or under the average during the ride.
Please always follow ride leader instructions.

name: KIRCHMAIR Beginners Race
description:
Die neue Kirchmair x RennRad Rennserie wir jeden Dienstag gefahren. In 10 Rennen könnt ihr auf spannenden Strecken gegeneinander antreten und die Form für das Frühjahr testen. Ein Rennen dauert ca. 45 Minuten und ist eine perfekte kurze und intensive Trainingseinheiten.

Die Auswertung erfolgt über Zwiftpower. Die besten 5 Ergebnisse gehen in die Gesamtwertung mit ein. Es gibt keine Segmentwertungen. Power-Ups (Aerohelm, Draftboost, Feder) werden an jedem Banner zufällig verteilt.

Für die besten Fahrerinnen und Fahrer jeder Kategorie in der Gesamtwertung gibt es jeweils Preise, die vom RennRad Magazin gesponsert werden. Außerdem erhalten die Erstplatzierten jedes Rennens eine kleine Überraschung. RennRad versorgt euch mit den besten Infos zu Radevents, Technik und Training: https://www.radsport-rennrad.de

Wichtig: Um einen Preis zu erhalten, müsst ihr einen Account bei Zwiftpower haben und in unserem Zwiftpower Team angemeldet sein: https://zwiftpower.com/team.php?id=2991

name: ZHCC RUBBERBAND CLUB
description:
Want a 100% guaranteed no drop ride? want a 100% guarantee you can ride at your own pace? want a 100% guarantee you WILL stay in the group,? want a 100% guarantee that the nasty fence will NOT kick you...........THEN LOOK NO FURTHER, this is the ride for you.
Try it - YOU MIGHT JUST LIKE IT!
Our ZHCC Rubber Band Club has the “rubber-band” activated which means that no matter what level you are, you will be able to keep up and the group WILL STAY TOGETHER. The rubber band allows you to ride at your own pace, slow or fast and you are guaranteed to stay in the group.
The ride speed will be slightly less than you would normally experience in a group ride due to the rubber band effect, but we feel that's a small price to pay to allow all level of riders to remain together throughout the ride.
In this supportive environment it’s a great way of completing a full 1 hour ride knowing you wont get dropped or get dragged along by those naughty fliers!
ZHCC do not race each other, we ride as one, have fun and enjoy a group ride.
The ZHCC gang look forward to riding with you.

name: Norwegian Watts Club BANDED social ride
description:
Welcome to Norwegian Watts Club social ride🙂

This ride is for all abilities--from first-timers to seasoned cyclists. Thanks to then banded ride feature, nobody gets left behind: as long as you keep pedaling, you'll stay with the group.
That means you can ride at your own pace,  focus on enjoying the route, and still be part of the bunch the whole way.

Our goal is simple: create a relaxed and supportive atmosphere where everyone feels at home. 
This ride isn't about Watts, KOMs, or race tactics-- it's about community,  good conversation,  and sharing the ride together.  Whether you're here to spin your legs,  make new Zwift friends,  or just enjoy some easy miles with like-minded rider, you'll find a warm welcome with the Norwegian Watts Club. 

What to Expect:

*All riders welcome -- no matter your pace or experience 

*Bande ride -- stick with the group just by pedaling 

*Social atmosphere  -- chat, laugh, encourage and ride together 

* A fun and supportive community 

So fire up Zwift, clip in and come ride with us.
It's not about how fast you go -- it's about who you ride with.
